name: KoLA
description: KoLA (Knowledge-oriented LLM Assessment) is a benchmark designed to evaluate the world knowledge of large language models. It features a four-level taxonomy of knowledge-related abilities covering 19 tasks, uses both Wikipedia and emerging corpora to test knowledge handling, and adopts a contrastive evaluation system including a self-contrast metric for knowledge-creating ability.
reputation: Publicly released dataset and leaderboard with continuous updates, indicating growing adoption.
notes: Evaluates knowledge-related abilities with a taxonomy and contrastive metrics; includes unseen and evolving knowledge corpora.
